context: Owner asked for a military look in the style of Call of Duty (tactical HUD feel); component library is Astryx, not hand-written components.

source.name: Infinity Ward (Call of Duty menus and loadout UI)

cards.borrowed: Bone-white caps with wide tracking on olive-black, top tab bar with one tan underline, flat list left and a detail column right, chamfered (clipped-corner) action button; tan accent under 10% of the surface.
cards.hero: The task list itself, with the selected row carrying the only tan marker.
cards.skeleton: Top tabs, four status strips, task table left, settings column right.
cards.boldness: Chamfered tan start button with stencil-width letterspacing.
cards.contentForm: Four status checks become olive/red edged strips; the queue reads like a loadout list.

cards.borrowed: One column, ruled tables, a double rule under the letterhead, one signal red used only for state and the stamp, typewriter body on khaki paper.
cards.hero: The letterhead 'OPERATION ORDER · 抢购令 No.001' and the rubber-stamp start button.
cards.skeleton: Letterhead, status line, four-cell check strip, ruled task table, settings as a form block below.
cards.boldness: The slightly rotated red stamp as the start control.
cards.contentForm: A buy order is a document: tasks are numbered lines, settings are the form fields below them.

source.name: Call of Duty: Warzone / Modern Warfare in-game HUD
source.unseenReason: callofduty.com navigation timed out at 30 s in the capture browser; the in-game HUD is not a web page, so no board could be captured.

cards.borrowed: Readouts anchored to screen corners, thin hairlines with corner ticks, mono numerals, one hot accent colour on a near-black field.
cards.hero: Four-corner readout of state, hotkey, checks and current target.
cards.skeleton: Left rail, status HUD strip, framed task table, framed inspector.
cards.boldness: Corner brackets on every panel and an outlined orange start key.
cards.contentForm: Run state and the F7 hotkey sit at the corners where a player looks first.

source.name: Escape from Tarkov (official site and inventory UI)

cards.borrowed: Chamfered-corner steel buttons and panels (45-degree clipped corners), brushed grey surfaces, dark glass overlay panels, cell-grid inventory.
cards.hero: The grid of item cells with one selected cell lit.
cards.contentForm: Targets are inventory items: a cell per weapon, the selected one lit.

source.style: 硬件面板 Hardware Panel（Teenage Engineering式，OP-1 / EP-133 的界面语言）

cards.borrowed: Labelled keys with silkscreen captions, physical key shadow, one orange active key on a warm grey face.
cards.hero: A 3x2 bank of keys carrying the four checks plus grade and route.
cards.boldness: Keys that look pressable with a hard bottom shadow.
cards.contentForm: Each check and setting is a key whose label and value fit in two lines.

source.style: 香港街招与招牌 Hong Kong Street Signs

cards.borrowed: Stacked saturated signboards, hazard yellow/red/black, slight rotation, heavy CJK display weight.
cards.hero: Three stacked signs: product, error, current target.
cards.boldness: Error state as a red sign across the whole width.
cards.contentForm: Errors and the active task become signage, shouted rather than listed.

directions.name: Field Manual
directions.thesis: Olive-black military menu where tan appears only on the selected row and the start button.
directions.signature: Chamfered tan start button with wide-tracked caps.

axes.layout: top tabs, list left, detail right

reasons.alone: A dense, readable operator console with a clear primary action and clear error strips.
reasons.distinct: Only dark olive version with top tabs and chamfered corners; dir-2 is light paper, dir-3 is near-black with a left rail.
reasons.ledger: Recent deliveries are light, centred pingfang pages; this is dark, left-aligned, DIN-style.
reasons.restraint: One accent; no props; flat fills.

directions.name: Ops Order
directions.thesis: A khaki operation-order sheet: the buy list is a document with ruled lines and one red stamp.
directions.signature: Rotated red rubber-stamp start button on a double-ruled letterhead.

reasons.alone: Reads as a clear order sheet; all state and controls fit on one page.
reasons.distinct: Only light, paper, single-column version; others are dark and panelled.
reasons.ledger: Light like recent deliveries but khaki/typewriter/ruled, not centred pingfang.
reasons.restraint: Stamp is the only gesture; no texture images.

directions.name: Tactical HUD
directions.thesis: Near-black HUD with hairline frames, corner ticks and a single hazard orange.
directions.signature: Corner-bracket frames and an outlined orange start key.

axes.typeFamily: light DIN-style sans with mono readouts
axes.layout: left rail nav, check strip, table and inspector

reasons.alone: A calm, scannable dashboard with state at a glance.
reasons.distinct: Only left-rail near-black HUD; dir-1 is olive top-tabbed, dir-2 is paper.
reasons.ledger: Dark with orange accent; recent deliveries had no accent and were light.
reasons.restraint: No glow or gradients; corner ticks are the one decoration.

decision.rationale: 选 dir-1，配色加 dir-3 的导轨。但我觉得还是太AI了，不够解构主义，加上我们的数学工业风格，很极简。
